trailhead.label: Sorafurcia (Geiselsberg) above Valdaora, about 1,350 m, the board’s start

cautions: A long, steady climb of over 900 m: only for fit dogs used to mountain days.
About 1.2 km of the climb is on asphalt and 2.4 km on forest roads, where farm and hut vehicles pass: keep your dog on a short lead.
The summit plateau is a busy lift area in summer, with gondolas, mountain bikes and crowds: keep your dog close.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
